title: Finite probabilistic guarantee
contract: Given a uniform four-element sample space, a coin mapping must return 0 and 1 with equal probability.
scope: Exactly four equally likely outcomes, all enumerated; no PRNG independence claim.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Each output has exactly half of total probability mass.

variants.description: Map three outcomes to zero and one to one.
Use high bit rather than low bit.
